detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

english.note: English proficiency evidence required for international applicants unless exempt. USC numerical thresholds on the central page concern exemption from the ISE placement exam, not admission minimums.

requirements.note: The program states application fees can be paid by MEB; contact the program. No rotations: admitted students are assigned an initial faculty advisor.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application and fellowship consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without an admission year; confirm the applicable cycle with the program.

funding.note: Support for all students throughout graduate study; admission offers include one fellowship year and at least four TA/RA years. Tuition remission, health center fee, health insurance and academic-year stipend provided.
